approved_by: Omri, 2026-09-24: cluster all features (not only the core) into virtual latent features by correlated errors, then L-SML on the K virtuals; label use accepted because generalization will be tested on external benchmarks
access: LABEL-USING DEVELOPMENT. PRMBench step labels (eligible answers, all folds) set each channel's orientation and the error-correlation clustering. L-SML weights are then fitted label-free on fit folds. ProcessBench labels are not used in the design, so ProcessBench is a partial transfer check. Not an unsupervised result; external benchmarks are the generalization test.
orientation: v2 (2026-09-24): sign of the channel's mean within-answer AUC on PRMBench eligible answers (high = error). v1 used the sign of the mean error-minus-nonerror difference, which disagreed with the AUC sign on 5 channels; v1 outputs are kept in run_20260924_v1_meandiff_orientation and are superseded.
error_correlation: within each answer, subtract the class mean (error / non-error) from each channel; Pearson correlation of these label-conditional residuals, pooled over PRMBench eligible steps, after orientation
clustering: average-linkage hierarchical clustering on 1 - error_corr; cut where average error correlation drops below r
virtuals: mean of oriented member z-scores, re-z-scored within answer

arms.errR_lsml: continuous L-SML on the K virtuals (anchor = virtual containing q15_H1)
arms.errR_equal: equal weights on the same K virtuals
arms.all48_oriented_lsml / _equal: same orientation, no clustering: separates orientation from clustering

folds_and_endpoints: identical to core_virtual_lsml_v1 (fit on three folds, calibrate on (k+1)%5, evaluate k; PRMBench within-AUC + PRMScore primary, ProcessBench macro8 first-error accuracy secondary; paired source-group bootstrap 20000)
reporting: all three thresholds reported; no threshold is selected as the method on these data
